name: ICDAR MapText datasets and artifacts (Zenodo community)
description: Shared datasets, evaluation scripts, and challenge artifacts for historical map text detection, recognition, and linking (MapText 2024-2025).

name: Paris historical directories, 1798-1914 (structured and geolocated)
description: Large-scale extraction and geolocation dataset from digitized Paris trade directories, released with the SoDUCo team.

name: French Trade Directories dataset for nested NER
description: Dataset of 19th-century French trade directories designed for nested named entity recognition benchmarks.

name: French Trade Directories (FTD)
description: Open dataset of 19th-century French trade directories used for information extraction and historical text processing experiments.

name: ICDAR 2021 Competition on Historical Map Segmentation dataset
description: Competition dataset for historical map segmentation tasks (building blocks, map content segmentation, and georeferencing intersections).

name: SmartDoc-QA
description: Dataset for quality assessment of smartphone-captured document images, including single and multiple distortions.

name: ICDAR 2015 SmartDoc challenge 1 dataset
description: Dataset and benchmark material for smartphone document capture and OCR challenge task 1.

name: ICDAR 2015 SmartDoc challenge 2 dataset
description: Dataset and benchmark material for smartphone document capture and OCR challenge task 2.

name: Text single-image super-resolution dataset (2013)
description: University of La Rochelle dataset for single text image super-resolution experiments.
